title: Navigating the Tides of Life
coreMove: Life tides rise and fall beyond total control, so discipline must anchor the person without denying changing emotional conditions.

exampleSpecs.audience: people treating low mood as permanent truth
exampleSpecs.stakes: a temporary condition can become identity if unnamed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the ocean tide metaphor to separate condition from truth

exampleSpecs.stakes: market turbulence can steal the practices that preserve judgment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use morning practice as steadiness under changing conditions

exampleSpecs.audience: artists interpreting one setback as destiny
exampleSpecs.stakes: a failed attempt can harden into false identity
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show pain moving through without becoming permanent identity

exampleSpecs.audience: people abandoning routines during hard seasons
exampleSpecs.stakes: rigidity can break the anchor it means to protect
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show recovery and perspective rather than constant strain

exampleSpecs.audience: people using acceptance to avoid repair
exampleSpecs.stakes: acceptance can become passivity if agency disappears
motivation shifts can dismantle study rhythm
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Track changing conditions while keeping the anchor
